Item 8.01

Other Events. 

On November 2, 2026, Dominion Energy, Inc. (the Company) entered into an underwriting agreement (the Underwriting Agreement) with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Mizuho Securities USA LLC, as Representatives for the underwriters named in the Underwriting Agreement, for the sale of (i) $600,000,000 aggregate principal amount of the Company’s 2026 Series B 5.25% Senior Notes due 2029 (Series B Senior Notes) and (ii) $600,000,000 aggregate principal amount of the Company’s 2026 Series C 5.95% Senior Notes due 2037 (Series C Senior Notes). The Series B Senior Notes and Series C Senior Notes are Senior Debt Securities that were registered by the Company under Rule 415 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, pursuant to a registration statement on Form 
S-3,
 which became effective on October 31, 2025 (File 
No. 333-291189).
 A copy of the Underwriting Agreement, including exhibits thereto, is filed as Exhibit 1.1 to this Form 
8-K.

The Thirty-Second and Thirty-Third Supplemental Indentures to the Company’s June 1, 2015 Senior Indenture, pursuant to which the Series B Senior Notes and Series C Senior Notes will be issued, respectively, are filed as Exhibits 4.2 and 4.3, respectively, to this Form 
8-K.
